name: Optus
summary: Australia's second-largest telco. Origins: AUSSAT (satellite carrier, 1981); relaunched as Optus Communications 1992 by a consortium including Cable & Wireless; traded as **Cable & Wireless Optus (CWO)** while C&W held control through 2001 (the 1997 IP index records CWO blocks: OPTUSCOM, CWO Customer/Infrastructure networks). Singtel acquired Optus in 2001 (US$8.5bn), trading as Singtel Optus (SINGTEL OPTUS PTY LIMITED, ACN 052 833 208). Consumer internet run as OptusNet and Optus@Home (cable broadband); related entities: at-home-network-australia (Optus/Excite@Home JV, control 2001).

events.details: AUSSAT (Australian Satellite System) established 1981; relaunched as Optus Communications 1992 (consortium incl. Cable & Wireless, BellSouth, AMP). Traded as Cable & Wireless Optus (CWO) while C&W held a controlling stake (1992-2001); Singtel acquired Optus in 2001 (US$8.5bn).

refs.label: ASX: Optus Communications announcement re SingTel ownership (23 Oct 2001)

events.details: The 1997 IP Network Index records Optus's then-current name as Cable & Wireless Optus (CWO), with netblocks OPTUSCOM, 'CWO Customer Network' and 'CWO Infrastructure Network' (202.139.x, 203.89.x) - matching the triaged 'not an ISP' corporate/infrastructure blocks. The Optus/Excite@Home cable JV was a separate entity (at-home-network-australia; Optus took control Sept 2001).
